mission.statement: A small, typed project editor lists and shows upstream projects, saves validated edits through its backend, resolves sequential stale-editor conflicts explicitly, and documents unavoidable upstream concurrency limits.
mission.terminal_signal: All three API routes and the React editor work against the real upstream; focused backend checks, ty, Ruff, frontend build, pre-commit, and live conflict smoke pass; README, DECISIONS.md, and AI_TRAIL.md are accurate.

goals.title: Freeze the shared baseline
goals.rationale: Every worktree needs one contract and reproducible dependencies before parallel code.
goals.completion_signal: SDD, backend/frontend lockfiles, buildable frontend scaffold, and hook configuration are reviewed and committed on one baseline; pre-commit validates and frontend builds.

goals.title: Define typed browser contracts
goals.rationale: Both lanes can implement independently only after the payload shapes and validation rules are represented in their languages.
goals.completion_signal: Backend models pass ty and frontend Zod schemas pass the TypeScript build.

goals.title: Build independent modules
goals.rationale: File-disjoint merge, upstream, client, and view work produces the largest safe parallel wave.
goals.completion_signal: Focused backend tests and frontend build pass after module branches merge.

goals.title: Assemble the two applications
goals.rationale: Routes and screen state can be wired independently once their modules exist.
goals.completion_signal: Backend API tests and frontend build pass in their separate worktrees.

goals.title: Integrate, verify, and hand off
goals.rationale: A real upstream flow and honest documentation prove the vertical slice and its limits.
goals.completion_signal: Live list/show/save/conflict and proxy checks pass; full pre-commit gate passes; handoff docs match observations.

tasks.title: Freeze SDD and API contract
tasks.rationale: A single reviewed source prevents backend/frontend contract drift.
tasks.acceptance_test: Compare the route, field, and failure tables against upstream/README.md and upstream/records_api/main.py.
tasks.sdd_snippet: This is the frozen contract for separate backend and frontend worktrees.

tasks.title: Lock backend dependencies
tasks.rationale: Backend workers must share the same typed FastAPI toolchain.
tasks.sdd_snippet: | Backend | Python 3.11+, FastAPI/Pydantic, HTTPX, Uvicorn | uv, pytest, Ruff, ty |

tasks.title: Lock frontend dependencies
tasks.rationale: Frontend workers need a reproducible React, MUI, and Zod toolchain.
tasks.sdd_snippet: | Frontend | React, MUI, Zod | TypeScript, Vite, npm |

tasks.title: Validate the commit gate
tasks.rationale: The common baseline should reject malformed or untyped work before feature branches diverge.
tasks.sdd_snippet: | Commit gate | pre-commit, Ruff hook, local ty/test/build hooks | pre-commit |

tasks.title: Create buildable frontend placeholder
tasks.rationale: A buildable frontend baseline lets independent component branches type-check before App assembly.
tasks.sdd_snippet: | Shared scaffold | Reproducible manifests and a buildable placeholder frontend before parallel work |

tasks.title: Implement backend Pydantic contracts
tasks.rationale: Server validation and projections must match the frozen browser API.
tasks.acceptance_test: cd backend && uv run ty check project_editor/contracts.py tests/test_contracts.py
tasks.sdd_snippet: | Backend models | Validate browser input and parse the wide upstream record; expose only small response models |

tasks.title: Implement frontend Zod contracts
tasks.rationale: The browser must parse and type the exact request and response shapes.
tasks.sdd_snippet: | Frontend schemas | Zod versions of the browser contract |

tasks.title: Implement pure three-way merge
tasks.rationale: Concurrent edit decisions need a small testable domain boundary.
tasks.acceptance_test: cd backend && uv run pytest -q tests/test_merge.py
tasks.sdd_snippet: `merge.py` exports `merge_edit(base: EditableFields, proposed: EditableFields, current: EditableFields) -> MergeResult`.

tasks.title: Implement upstream adapter
tasks.rationale: Full replacement and ambiguous responses belong at one HTTP boundary.
tasks.acceptance_test: cd backend && uv run pytest -q tests/test_upstream.py
tasks.sdd_snippet: It signals missing projects, unavailable reads, and uncertain writes distinctly.

tasks.title: Implement frontend API client
tasks.rationale: All browser requests need one relative /api boundary and Zod response parsing.
tasks.sdd_snippet: `api.ts` exports `listProjects()`, `getProject(id)`, and `saveProject(id, base, proposed)`; save returns a discriminated result for `saved`, `conflict`, or `uncertain`.

tasks.title: Implement project list view
tasks.rationale: Listing and selection can be built without editing form or app assembly files.
tasks.sdd_snippet: `ProjectList.tsx` receives summaries, selected ID, loading state, and an `onSelect(id)` callback.

tasks.title: Implement form and conflict views
tasks.rationale: Date editing and per-field conflict choices are file-disjoint from the list and API client.
tasks.sdd_snippet: `ProjectForm.tsx` receives a draft, saving/disabled state, and `onChange(nextDraft)` and `onSave()` callbacks; it owns field and date-row controls but no network or project selection.

tasks.title: Wire backend list, show, and save routes
tasks.rationale: Routes combine validated input, merge decisions, and upstream I/O.
tasks.acceptance_test: cd backend && uv run pytest -q tests/test_api.py
tasks.sdd_snippet: `main.py` alone maps those outcomes to the browser HTTP responses. No worker adds a fourth endpoint.

tasks.title: Wire frontend screen and proxy
tasks.rationale: Screen state combines isolated views and the API client against the backend path.
tasks.sdd_snippet: `App.tsx` owns selection, base/draft snapshots, conflict rebase, uncertainty, and API orchestration.

tasks.title: Run live smoke and record limits
tasks.rationale: A real upstream flow proves the main path and grounds concurrency claims.
tasks.acceptance_test: With all three services running, assert list/show, two distinct edits, one 409 conflict, and Vite /api proxy.
tasks.sdd_snippet: The three-way merge handles sequential stale editors. It cannot close the gap between its fresh read and upstream `PUT`.

tasks.title: Write exact run instructions
tasks.rationale: The interview needs a reproducible startup path from a clean shell.
tasks.acceptance_test: Follow README commands from a clean checkout until the project list loads.
tasks.sdd_snippet: | Handoff | Human setup instructions, tradeoffs, and AI trail |

tasks.title: Record AI trail and final gate
tasks.rationale: The submission must state what AI produced, what was corrected, and what was actually verified.
tasks.sdd_snippet: | Handoff | Human setup instructions, tradeoffs, and AI trail |
